question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Submit true exactly when any LC_LOAD_DYLIB dylib path ends with libSystem.B.dylib and every dylib path starts with /usr/lib/. Submit lowercase true or false.
oracle_cmd: { python3 -c "from macholib.MachO import MachO; [print(c[2].rstrip(b'\0').decode()) for h in MachO('pg_macho.bin').headers for c in h.commands if c[0].cmd in (0xc, 0x80000018, 0x8000001f, 0x20, 0x80000023)]" | grep -q 'libSystem.B.dylib$' && ! python3 -c "from macholib.MachO import MachO; [print(c[2].rstrip(b'\0').decode()) for h in MachO('pg_macho.bin').headers for c in h.commands if c[0].cmd in (0xc, 0x80000018, 0x8000001f, 0x20, 0x80000023)]" | grep -qv '^/usr/lib/'; } && echo true || echo false
